instruction: Studio portrait photograph, full shot, side-angle view. In an indoor studio with a draped beige fabric backdrop, three generations of women stand barefoot. On the left, the younger woman with medium-length brown hair (R2) stands in profile, wearing a white shirt and wide-leg blue jeans. On the right, the older woman with short dark hair (R1) stands in profile, wearing a white shirt and blue jeans. Between them, the little girl with light brown hair (R3) is held in the air, wearing a white blouse and light blue jeans. R2 and R1 jointly support R3, who places her hands on R2's face. Soft, diffused studio lighting illuminates the warm, neutral-toned scene.
